title: Groundsource: A Dataset of Flood Events from News
creators: Mayo, Zlydenko, Bootbool, Fronman, Gilon, Hassidim et al. (Google Research)
contents: 2,646,302 news-derived flood events worldwide, 2000-01-01 to 2026-02-03: uuid, area_km2, geometry (WKB, WGS84), start_date, end_date. No flood type or country field.
